title: Kem Ley ninth-anniversary commemoration calling for justice and independent investigation
location: Caltex Bokor Star Mart, Phnom Penh; participants later proceeded to Wat Chas pagoda in Chroy Changva district
scope: City-level gathering in Phnom Penh; no nationwide organization established
organizer: Civil society groups, unionists, youth activists and opposition members; named participants from CENTRAL and Cambodian Youth Network
participants_original: CamboJA: more than 100 attendees. LICADHO: around 200 attendees.
threshold_50_evidence: Both contemporary reports place attendance above 100 (CamboJA: more than 100; LICADHO: around 200), exceeding 50. Figures remain qualitative/approximate and are not converted into an exact range.

start_date.summary: Both reports date the anniversary gathering to 10 July 2025.

location.summary: At the Caltex/Bokor Star Mart site in central Phnom Penh; later ceremonial continuation at Wat Chas in Chroy Changva.

organizer.summary: Participants included civil society, union and youth groups; no single organizer established.

demands.summary: Calls for justice for Kem Ley and his family, an independent/full investigation, and accountability.

participants_original.summary: CamboJA says more than 100; LICADHO says around 200.

state_target.summary: Calls seek investigation and justice from Cambodian authorities/court and government.

state_response.summary: Police looked on according to CamboJA; no accommodation, arrests, force or other action established. Keep all state-response categories unknown.

protester_violence.summary: Neither source explicitly reports protester violence or explicitly establishes its absence.

end_date.summary: The gathering continued to Wat Chas the same day for a Buddhist ceremony; exact ending time unknown.

notes: This is an executed 2025 gathering, not an announcement or the 2016 killing. Keep participant reports qualitative. No arrests or police repression are inferred from historical context.
open_questions: Was a formal independent inquiry requested in a petition or letter?
Did authorities respond to the 2025 call?
